scoring_justification: Headline quantities are DFT-calculated energies and spin populations, which the verifier cannot recompute; ordering, closeness, and threshold relationships derived from the paper's tables are validated.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference adsorption energies for trend checks
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 3 and Table 4 of paper (VASP PW91 optimized with relaxation)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's reported DFT results.

hidden_assets.purpose: spin population thresholds and reference max_abs_spin
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 6 (B3LYP Mulliken spin polarizations) and paper text (Ti spin near 1, H <0.1)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's discussion: Ti spin >0.5 e, H spin <0.1 e. Reference values used for validation of thresholds.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Thresholds are based on the paper's qualitative conclusion that spin localizes on Ti (values near unity) and H retains negligible spin.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 7 (VASP PW91) and paper text (reduction >0.3 eV)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's claim of significant decrease: 3L diff ~1.22 eV, 6L diff ~0.53 eV, with >0.3 eV as a minimal threshold.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Threshold ensures the qualitative trend of decreased acidity upon hydrogenation is reproduced.

outputs.description: Hydrogen adsorption energies per two H atoms for each slab thickness and adsorption model. Checker compares ordering (R > H1, R > H2) and values to hidden paper reference within tolerance.

Maximum absolute Mulliken (or Bader) spin populations on Ti and H atoms for the R model on selected slabs. Checker verifies that for at least one slab, max_abs_spin_Ti > 0.5 e and max_abs_spin_H < 0.1 e.
NH3 adsorption energies on clean and hydrogenated TiO2(110) slabs. Checker verifies that for each slab, E_ads_NH3(clean) - E_ads_NH3(H_covered) > 0.3 eV.

output_contract.notes: All checks are performed at the result level (T0) against the paper's VASP PW91 reference values, with tolerances absorbing code-to-code spread. Process steps must be executed to reach the scored artifacts; the spin and NH3 steps are load-bearing.
